The structure of Cr₄Cd₄Ge₄S₁₆ (reduced formula CrCdGeS₄) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Fddd (No. 216), with 28 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cd and Cr each coordinated by six S neighbors in octahedral motifs, while Ge is tetrahedrally coordinated by four S neighbors. Corner-sharing between Cd octahedra and Ge tetrahedra, as well as between Cr octahedra and Ge tetrahedra, is observed, and the neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
